entities.summary: Peter Otis Gray is an American psychology researcher and scholar. He is a research professor of psychology at Boston College, and the author of an introductory psychology textbook. Gray's research explores the relationship between neuroendocrinology, developmental psychology, anthropology and education. He is known for his work on the interaction between education and play, and for his evolutionary perspective on psychology theory.
